# Dictami

> Offline voice dictation for Mac (Apple Silicon). Hold a key, speak, and punctuated text appears at the cursor in any app. Recognition runs on the device; no account is needed.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Intel Macs are not supported.
- Current version: 1.2.28
- Languages: 30 fast on-device languages with punctuation; other languages via Whisper (slower).
- Works without internet after a one-time model download.
- Pricing (USD): 7-day free trial in the app, no card. Card: $5.99/month or $29.99 lifetime. Crypto: one-time payments ($5.99 for 30 days or $29.99 lifetime).
- Refunds: within 14 days.
- Download: https://dictami.com/Dictami.dmg
